title: RELIGIOUS EXCITEMENT--JOSEPH'S PROPHECY--HE WORKS FOR MR
author: Lucy Mack Smith
book: History Of Prophet Joseph By His Mother
note: 1902 revised edition (George A. Smith / Elias Smith). 54 chapters. Mother's first-hand account of the Smith family.

footnotes.text: This project of Stoal's was undertaken from this cause--an old document had fallen into his possession, in some way or other, containing information of silver mines being somewhere in the neighborhood in which he resided.
